mfe_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: max favourable excursion over the bars held (conservative in the exit bar)

mae_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: max adverse excursion over the bars held (<= 0)

gapfill_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: 1 when the stop was filled at a bar Open beyond the stop level (H0k)

samebar_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: 1 when the exit bar touched both the stop and the target (booked as stop)

pnl_mtm_k0_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: mark-to-market P&L at the close of positional bar k while open; NaN from the exit bar on or when the bar is missing

pnl_mtm_k1_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: mark-to-market P&L at the close of positional bar k while open; NaN from the exit bar on or when the bar is missing

pnl_mtm_k8_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: mark-to-market P&L at the close of positional bar k while open; NaN from the exit bar on or when the bar is missing

traded_open.desc: 1 when the candidate is fillable at the 18:00 open (not already_past_open, not open_past_stop)

eur_outcome_post.desc: 17:00-close fill: a scratch held into Europe (03:00-08:59) with the levels active: target / stop / neither

eur_pnl_post.desc: 17:00-close fill: P&L of that Europe hold (exit at the level, else the Europe close)

pnl_at_eur_close_post.desc: 17:00-close fill: mark-to-market P&L of the scratch at the last Europe bar close

eur_outcome_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: a scratch held into Europe (03:00-08:59) with the levels active: target / stop / neither

eur_pnl_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: P&L of that Europe hold (exit at the level, else the Europe close)

pnl_at_eur_close_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: mark-to-market P&L of the scratch at the last Europe bar close

e20_k.desc: positional index of the hour-20 bar (2 normally)

entry_e20.desc: fill price of the 20:00-open variant (Open of the hour-20 bar)

pre_touched_target_e20.desc: target touched in the bars before the 20:00 open

pre_touched_stop_e20.desc: stop touched in the bars before the 20:00 open

traded_e20.desc: 1 when the candidate is fillable at the 20:00 open (same two checks at that open)

outcome_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: target / stop / scratch (None when not traded)

resolved_k_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: positional Asia bar index of the exit (0 = first bar, normally 18:00); NaN for scratch

exit_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: exit price (stop level, bar Open on a gap through the stop, target level, or the last Asia close)

pnl_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: signed gross P&L of the candidate from its fill (0 when not traded)

mfe_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: max favourable excursion over the bars held (conservative in the exit bar)

mae_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: max adverse excursion over the bars held (<= 0)

gapfill_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: 1 when the stop was filled at a bar Open beyond the stop level (H0k)

samebar_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: 1 when the exit bar touched both the stop and the target (booked as stop)

pnl_mtm_k0_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: mark-to-market P&L at the close of positional bar k while open; NaN from the exit bar on or when the bar is missing

pnl_mtm_k1_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: mark-to-market P&L at the close of positional bar k while open; NaN from the exit bar on or when the bar is missing

event_night.desc: 1 when the event cost applies (sunday_open, |post_ret| > 0.3%, megacap_earnings_tonight)

cost_base.desc: round-trip cost, base schedule: NQ 1.5 (ES 0.75) weeknight; 4.0 (2.0) on Sunday reopens, |post_ret| > 0.3% or mega-cap earnings

cost_hi.desc: round-trip cost, sensitivity: NQ 4.0 / ES 2.0 every night

pnl_net_post.desc: 17:00-close fill: pnl_post - cost_base when the candidate is fillable, 0 otherwise (candidate level, NOT grade-gated; the night's grade is in `grade`)

pnl_net_post_hicost.desc: 17:00-close fill: pnl_post - cost_hi when fillable, 0 otherwise (candidate level, NOT grade-gated)

pnl_net_open.desc: 18:00-open fill: pnl_open - cost_base when the candidate is fillable, 0 otherwise (candidate level, NOT grade-gated; the night's grade is in `grade`)

pnl_net_open_hicost.desc: 18:00-open fill: pnl_open - cost_hi when fillable, 0 otherwise (candidate level, NOT grade-gated)

pnl_net_e20.desc: 20:00-open variant: pnl_e20 - cost_base when the candidate is fillable, 0 otherwise (candidate level, NOT grade-gated; the night's grade is in `grade`)

pnl_net_e20_hicost.desc: 20:00-open variant: pnl_e20 - cost_hi when fillable, 0 otherwise (candidate level, NOT grade-gated)

grade.desc: honest grade (causal calibration + walk-forward regressors): A >= 72, B >= 63, C >= 56, NO EDGE, '-' = NO TRADE

splice.desc: 1 on asia_extremes.SPLICE_SESSIONS nights (contract splice; excluded from every statistic)
